literature.headline_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人乳头瘤病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: α-HPV感染率为59.9%,25%的女性存在多重感染。最常见的高危型基因型为HPV52(8.2%)、HPV51(6.9%)和HPV56(5.8%)。HPV16仅在4.3%的女性中检出,且存在于四名高级别病变女性中的三名中。高危型HPV感染率在27.9%至57.1%之间,取决于研究期间。 [10.1007/s00705-026-06722-1]

加纳筛查组的 HPV 阳性率为 34.9%,其中 39.2% 的阳性病例检测到多种基因型。加纳筛查组中的主要HPV基因型是HPV-39(19.0%),在较年轻的年龄组(<30岁)中尤其流行,其次是HPV-53(15.2%)和HPV-68(15.2%)。在加纳研究小组中,HPV-53 是最常见的基因型(18.9%),其次是 HPV-39(18.0%)。在临床医生收集的组中,HPV-16 (18.6%) 是最常见的基因型。在独立寻求 HPV 检测的参与者自行收集的样本中,HPV-39 (17.9%) 和 HPV-51 (17.9%) 是最常见的基因型。在规模小得多的肯尼亚筛查组中,HPV-51 (46.2%) 是最常见的基因型。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0355868]
使用40份疫苗接种参与者的血清样本进行初步比较,结果显示与假病毒颗粒中和试验(PBNA)的符合率为97.5%,且相关性良好(R2 > 0.95)。 [10.1016/j.jviromet.2026.115452]
任何HPV基因型的总体发病率为每1000人月42.1例,HPV16(5.6/1000人月)、HPV6(4.1/1000人月)与HPV58(3.2/1000人月)为最常见新发基因型。持续感染率为28.0%,HPV11(4.5%)、HPV6(4.0%)与HPV16(3.5%)为主要持续感染基因型。任何HPV基因型的清除率为每1000人月102.6例。 [10.1093/ofid/ofag352]
12%的肺癌标本中检测到HPV,其中HPV16是最常见的基因型,占阳性病例的75%。 [10.7759/cureus.115322]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Alpha-HPV prevalence was 59.9% with 25% of women having multiple infections. The most prevalent high-risk types were HPV52 (8.2%), HPV51 (6.9%) and HPV56 (5.8%). HPV16 was detected in 4.3% of women and present in three of four women with high-grade lesions. [10.1007/s00705-026-06722-1]

HPV positivity in the Ghana screening group was 34.9%, with multiple genotypes detected in 39.2% of the positive cases. The main HPV genotype in the Ghana screening group was HPV-39 (19.0%), which was especially prevalent in the younger age group (<30 years), followed by HPV-53 (15.2%) and HPV-68 (15.2%). [10.1371/journal.pone.0355868]

A preliminary comparison using 40 serum samples from vaccinated participants showed 97.5% agreement and a strong correlation (R2 > 0.95) with the pseudovirion-based neutralization assay (PBNA). [10.1016/j.jviromet.2026.115452]

The overall incidence of any HPV genotype was 42.1 per 1000 person-months (pm), with HPV16 (5.6/1000 pm), HPV6 (4.1/1000 pm), and HPV58 (3.2/1000 pm) being the most common incident genotypes. Persistent infections were observed in 28.0%, with HPV11 (4.5%), HPV6 (4.0%), and HPV16 (3.5%) as the top persistent genotypes. [10.1093/ofid/ofag352]
HPV was detected in 12% of the lung cancer specimens, with HPV16 being the most prevalent genotype, accounting for 75% of the positive cases. [10.7759/cureus.115322]

news.headline_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期人乳头瘤病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 《分子生物学报告》的一篇综述提出将高危型HPV基因分型与非编码RNA谱系分析相结合,以区分一过性感染与潜在致癌感染。该提案被呈现为研究理念而非已验证的临床检测方法,作者指出存在显著的证据缺口(证据N1、N3、N40、N43)。 [news-9798cf952febd51c]
泰国的一项小型试点研究检查了接受造血干细胞移植的青少年的抗体耐久性和 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 的抗体耐久性。研究发现,两剂四价 HPV 疫苗 产生针对 HPV16 和 HPV18 的强烈而持久的抗体反应。 [news-d426c900101b02a4]
三项新研究表明,HPV 疫苗 可显着降低男性肛门和生殖器 HPV 感染的风险。日本的一项随机试验发现 Gardasil 9 降低了肛门或生殖器 HPV 感染的风险,加拿大的一项真实世界研究证实了 疫苗接种 对年轻男性的有效性。 [news-c374fa77e0f3dd20]
带状疱疹疫苗接种与未来7年心脏病风险降低相关 梅根·霍洛汉 相较于已停用的减毒活疫苗,重组带状疱疹疫苗可能更有效地保护人们免受不适感染之外的多重危害。 [news-0c3c34e8102ac652]
NHS 宣布为英格兰未参加宫颈筛查预约的女性推出免费的家用 HPV 检测套件。这是根据官方公告确认的事件。 [news-f423d8907c4c6eec]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Human papillomaviruses news developments.
key_findings_en: A review in Molecular Biology Reports proposes combining HPV genotyping with non‐coding RNA profiling to distinguish transient from potentially oncogenic infections. The proposal is presented as a research concept, not a validated clinical test, and the authors note significant evidence gaps (evidence N1, N3, N40, N43). [news-9798cf952febd51c]

A small pilot study from Thailand examined the antibody durability and immune response to the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in adolescents who had undergone hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. [news-d426c900101b02a4]

Three new studies show that HPV vaccines significantly reduce the risk of anal and genital HPV infections in men. A randomized trial from Japan found Gardasil 9 reduced the risk of developing anal or genital HPV infections, and a real-world study from Canada confirmed the effectiveness of vaccination in younger men. [news-c374fa77e0f3dd20]

Shingles vaccine linked to lower risk of heart disease for 7 years Meghan Holohan Relative to the discontinued live vaccine, the recombinant vaccine may better protect people from more than an uncomfortable infection. [news-0c3c34e8102ac652]

The NHS announced the rollout of free at-home HPV testing kits for women in England who have not attended cervical screening appointments. This is a confirmed event based on the official announcement. [news-f423d8907c4c6eec]

papers.title: Multifocal HPV16-positive squamous cell carcinomas in CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency: expanding the spectrum of virus-associated malignancies
papers.abstract: Abstract Cytotoxic T-lymphocyte associated protein 4 (CTLA-4) haploinsufficiency is an inborn error of immunity characterized by immune dysregulation, autoimmunity, lymphoproliferation, and an increased risk of malignancy. While susceptibility to oncogenic viral infections has been proposed, the relationship between CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency and human papillomavirus (HPV)-driven carcinogenesis remains poorly characterized. We describe a patient with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency who developed multiple HPV-associated malignancies. Clinical, pathological, virological, and genetic data were reviewed. Germline genetic testing was performed using whole-exome sequencing, and HPV DNA analysis was conducted on available tumor specimens. A man with a history of alopecia totalis and autoimmune thyroiditis developed five distinct malignancies by the age of 50 years, including Epstein–Barr virus (EBV)-associated gastric Hodgkin lymphoma, cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), and three independent HPV16-positive SCCs involving the oral cavity, anus, and penis. Germline testing identified CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency caused by a likely pathogenic CTLA4 variant, c.406C > T (p.Pro136Ser). No additional germline variants associated with hereditary cancer predisposition were detected. HPV DNA analysis demonstrated HPV16 positivity in all three mucosal SCCs. This case expands the spectrum of malignancies associated with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency and suggests that persistent high-risk HPV infection may represent an underrecognized complication of this disorder. The occurrence of three independent HPV16-positive SCCs raises the possibility that CTLA-4 deficiency predisposes to HPV-driven carcinogenesis and supports further investigation of HPV surveillance and cancer prevention strategies in affected individuals.

While susceptibility to oncogenic viral infections has been proposed, the relationship between CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency and human papillomavirus (HPV)-driven carcinogenesis remains poorly characterized. We describe a patient with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency who developed multiple HPV-associated malignancies. Clinical, pathological, virological, and genetic data were reviewed. Germline genetic testing was performed using whole-exome sequencing, and HPV DNA analysis was conducted on available tumor specimens. A man with a history of alopecia totalis and autoimmune thyroiditis developed five distinct malignancies by the age of 50 years, including Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-associated gastric Hodgkin lymphoma, cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), and three independent HPV16-positive SCCs involving the oral cavity, anus, and penis. Germline testing identified CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency caused by a likely pathogenic CTLA4 variant, c.406C > T (p.Pro136Ser). No additional germline variants associated with hereditary cancer predisposition were detected. HPV DNA analysis demonstrated HPV16 positivity in all three mucosal SCCs. This case expands the spectrum of malignancies associated with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency and suggests that persistent high-risk HPV infection may represent an underrecognized complication of this disorder. The occurrence of three independent HPV16-positive SCCs raises the possibility that CTLA-4 deficiency predisposes to HPV-driven carcinogenesis and supports further investigation of HPV surveillance and cancer prevention strategies in affected individuals.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review investigates the association between CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency and the development of multiple HPV-associated malignancies, focusing on the role of high-risk HPV types, particularly HPV16, in carcinogenesis. The central question is whether CTLA-4 deficiency predisposes to HPV-driven cancers and how this relationship might be underrecognized.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case report of a patient with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency who developed multiple HPV-associated malignancies. Clinical, pathological, virological, and genetic data were reviewed, with germline genetic testing conducted via whole-exome sequencing and HPV DNA analysis performed on tumor specimens. The review does not involve a meta-analysis or pooling of data from multiple studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report describes a patient with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency who developed three independent HPV16-positive squamous cell carcinomas (SCCs) in different anatomical sites (oral cavity, anus, and penis), along with other HPV-associated malignancies. HPV DNA analysis confirmed HPV16 positivity in all three mucosal SCCs, and no additional germline variants associated with hereditary cancer predisposition were detected. This case expands the spectrum of malignancies linked to CTLA-4 deficiency and suggests that persistent high-risk HPV infection may be an underrecognized complication of this condition.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the lack of comprehensive understanding regarding the relationship between CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency and HPV-driven carcinogenesis. While the case report provides evidence of multiple HPV-associated malignancies in a single patient, it does not establish a causal link or provide broader population-level data. The study is limited to a single case, which may not be representative of the general population, and there is no mention of other potential risk factors or mechanisms.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The occurrence of three independent HPV16-positive SCCs in a patient with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency raises the possibility that this condition may predispose individuals to HPV-driven carcinogenesis. This suggests the need for further research into HPV surveillance and cancer prevention strategies in individuals with CTLA-4 deficiency. Additionally, there is a call for increased awareness of the potential for persistent high-risk HPV infection in such patients.

analysis.summary_en: This review presents a case report of a patient with CTLA-4 haploinsufficiency who developed multiple HPV-associated malignancies, including three independent HPV16-positive squamous cell carcinomas. The study highlights the potential link between CTLA-4 deficiency and HPV-driven carcinogenesis, suggesting that persistent high-risk HPV infection may be an underrecognized complication. While the evidence is based on a single case, it expands the known spectrum of malignancies associated with this condition and underscores the need for further research into HPV surveillance and prevention strategies in affected individuals.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 细胞毒性T淋巴细胞相关蛋白4(CTLA-4)单倍不足是一种先天性免疫缺陷,以免疫调节失衡、自身免疫、淋巴细胞增殖及恶性肿瘤风险增加为特征。尽管已提出对致瘤性病毒感染的易感性,但CTLA-4单倍不足与人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)驱动的致癌作用之间的关系仍鲜有特征描述。本文报道一例CTLA-4单倍不足患者出现多发HPV相关性恶性肿瘤。回顾了临床、病理、病毒学及遗传学数据。采用全外显子组测序进行生殖系遗传学检测,并对可用的肿瘤标本进行HPV DNA分析。一名50岁时已出现五种不同恶性肿瘤的男性(既往有全秃及自身免疫性甲状腺炎病史),包括EB病毒(EBV)相关性胃霍奇金淋巴瘤、皮肤鳞状细胞癌(SCC)及三处独立的HPV16阳性SCC,累及口腔、肛门及阴茎。生殖系检测确认CTLA-4单倍不足,由一罕见致病CTLA4变异c.406C > T(p.Pro136Ser)所致。未检测到其他与遗传性癌症易感相关的生殖系变异。HPV DNA分析显示三处黏膜SCC标本均为HPV16阳性。本病例扩展了与CTLA-4单倍不足相关的恶性肿瘤谱系,并提示持续性HPV感染可能是该病的未被充分认识的并发症。三处独立HPV16阳性SCC的发生提示CTLA-4缺陷可能使个体易患HPV驱动性致癌,并支持在受累个体中进一步调查HPV感染与癌症预防策略。

papers.title: Incidence and Prevalence of Human Papillomavirus Infection to Predict Outcomes from HPV-Based Cervical Cancer Screening in Women and People with a Cervix Living with HIV
papers.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) testing has been implemented in many organized cervix screening programs; however, understanding how this screening methodology affects rates of colposcopy and further follow-up procedures remains underexplored, especially among women with HIV. In the absence of HPV screening program data in British Columbia (BC), Canada, we sought to determine HPV prevalence and estimates for colposcopies among a cohort of women with HIV using the BC Cervix Screening algorithm. Setting: HPV data were collected and analyzed from a prospective HPV vaccine immunogenicity cohort study of women with HIV from 14 sites of HIV care across Canada from 2008 to 2015. Methods: HPV data were obtained during the screening (month −3), baseline (month 0), month 12, and month 24 time points (Linear Array assay). Participant demographic and clinical characteristics (CD4 + count, HIV viral load, etc.) were assessed to determine associations between HPV prevalence and estimates for colposcopy using rate ratios and 95% confidence intervals. Results: Overall, 47.2% of participants had oncogenic HPV detected at screening which would result in a colposcopy referral. In total, 15.9% of participants had oncogenic HPV detected at screening, month 12, and month 24 time points, which would result in 3 consecutive referrals to colposcopy. Participants with repeat oncogenic HPV detected were less likely to have a suppressed HIV viral load compared with participants without oncogenic HPV detected. Conclusions: Results of this study suggest that HPV testing will result in a high proportion of referrals to colposcopy and follow-up procedures among women with HIV, which will require preparation and planning. Further work is needed to provide the appropriate support and education for women with HIV when incorporating HPV testing into cervix screening programs.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to assess the impact of HPV testing on colposcopy referral rates among women with HIV in Canada. HPV data were collected from a prospective cohort study across 14 HIV care sites between 2008 and 2015. The Linear Array assay was used to detect oncogenic HPV at screening, baseline, and follow-up time points. Results showed that 47.2% of participants had oncogenic HPV detected at screening, leading to colposcopy referrals, and 15.9% had persistent HPV infection over 24 months, resulting in three consecutive referrals. The authors concluded that HPV testing in this population will significantly increase colposcopy referrals, necessitating planning and resource allocation. They emphasized the need for further support and education for women with HIV in cervical cancer screening programs. The study's findings are relevant for improving screening strategies but are limited by the cohort design and potential confounding factors.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: HPV数据来自一项针对感染HIV女性的前瞻性HPV免疫原性队列研究,该研究在加拿大14个HIV护理中心进行,时间跨度为2008年至2015年。

elements_zh.main_results: 整体而言,47.2%的参与者在筛查阶段检测出致癌型HPV,需转诊至阴道镜检查。共有15.9%的参与者在筛查、第12个月及第24个月时间点均检测出致癌型HPV,需接受3次连续的阴道镜检查转诊。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究结果表明,HPV检测将导致感染HIV女性群体中大量阴道镜检查及后续随访程序的转诊,需提前做好准备与规划。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可为感染HIV女性群体的HPV筛查项目制定提供科学依据,并强调需充足资源与支持以应对转诊率的增加。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其依赖队列研究设计,以及可能的混杂因素(如HIV病毒载量)可能影响HPV与阴道镜检查转诊率。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 检测已在许多有组织的子宫颈筛查计划中实施;然而,了解这种筛查方法如何影响阴道镜检查率和进一步的随访程序仍有待探索,特别是在感染艾滋病毒的女性中。由于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省 (BC) 缺乏 HPV 筛查计划数据,我们试图使用 BC 子宫颈筛查算法确定感染 HIV 的 队列研究 女性中的 HPV 患病率 和阴道镜检查的估计值。背景:HPV 数据是从 2008 年至 2015 年加拿大 14 个 HIV 护理地点的 HIV 感染女性的前瞻性 HPV 疫苗 免疫原性 队列研究 研究中收集和分析的。方法:在筛查(第 -3 个月)、基线(第 0 个月)、第 12 个月和第 24 个月时间点(线性阵列测定)期间获得 HPV 数据。评估参与者的人口统计和临床特征(CD4 + 计数、HIV 病毒载量等),以确定 HPV 患病率 与使用比率和 95% 置信区间的阴道镜检查估计值之间的关联。结果:总体而言,47.2% 的参与者在筛查时检测到致癌 HPV,这将导致转诊阴道镜检查。总共有 15.9% 的参与者在筛查、第 12 个月和第 24 个月的时间点检测到致癌 HPV,这将导致连续 3 次转诊进行阴道镜检查。与未检测到致癌 HPV 的参与者相比,重复检测到致癌 HPV 的参与者 HIV 病毒载量受到抑制的可能性较小。结论:这项研究的结果表明,HPV 检测将导致 HIV 感染女性中较高比例的转诊到阴道镜检查和后续程序,这需要做好准备和规划。将 HPV 检测纳入子宫颈筛查计划时,需要开展进一步的工作,为感染艾滋病毒的女性提供适当的支持和教育。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: HPV检测已在多个组织化宫颈癌筛查项目中实施;然而,这种筛查方法如何影响阴道镜检查及后续随访程序的发生率仍鲜有探索,尤其是在感染HIV的女性群体中。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: HPV数据来自一项针对感染HIV女性的前瞻性HPV免疫原性队列研究,该研究在加拿大14个HIV护理中心进行,时间跨度为2008年至2015年。
analysis_zh.methods: HPV数据通过筛查(第-3个月)、基线(第0个月)、第12个月及第24个月时间点收集并分析(Linear Array检测法)。收集参与者人口统计学和临床特征(CD4+计数、HIV病毒载量等)以确定HPV与阴道镜检查转诊率的关联,并采用率比及95%置信区间进行估计。
analysis_zh.main_results: 整体而言,47.2%的参与者在筛查阶段检测出致癌型HPV,需转诊至阴道镜检查。共有15.9%的参与者在筛查、第12个月及第24个月时间点均检测出致癌型HPV,需接受3次连续的阴道镜检查转诊。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究结果表明,HPV检测将导致感染HIV女性群体中大量阴道镜检查及后续随访程序的转诊,需提前做好准备与规划。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可为感染HIV女性群体的HPV筛查项目制定提供科学依据,并强调需充足资源与支持以应对转诊率的增加。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其依赖队列研究设计,以及可能的混杂因素(如HIV病毒载量)可能影响HPV与阴道镜检查转诊率。

papers.title: Frequent detection of high-risk HPV types other than HPV 16/18 in a cohort of French women who claimed to have been vaccinated
papers.abstract: This study aimed to estimate the prevalence and distribution of HPV in a cohort of vaccinated French women undergoing cervical cancer screening (CCS). Women vaccinated against HPV (either by the bivalent HPV16/18, the quadrivalent HPV6/11/16/18 or the nonavalent HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58 vaccine) and for whom a cervical specimen had been collected were included. Detection and genotyping of 32 alpha-HPV genotypes (HPV6/11/16/18/26/31/33/35/39/40/42/43/44/45/51/52/53/54/56/58/59/61/62/66/67/68/70/73/81/82/83/89) was systematically performed (INNO-LIPA, Fujirebio). In a sub-study, high-risk HPV (hrHPV) was detected using two different HPV screening tests, according to the study period. 464 vaccinated women were included. Cytology was normal for 80.6% of them. The prevalence of alpha-HPV was 59.9% in vaccinated women and 25% of whom had multiple infections. The most prevalent hrHPV genotypes were HPV52 (8.2%), HPV51 (6.9%), and HPV56 (5.8%). HPV16 was detected in only 4.3% of women and was present in three of the four women with a high-grade lesion. In the sub-study, 238 women underwent hrHPV screening. The prevalence of hrHPV ranged from 27.9% to 57.1%, depending on the study period and CCS practices. Alpha-HPV, including high-risk HPV, are frequently detected in vaccinated French women. However, most of the genotypes that have been detected are not covered by the vaccines. The prevalence of HPV 16/18 is low, which confirms the efficacy of HPV vaccines. The implementation of the nonavalent vaccine may change the future epidemiology of hrHPV genotypes.

papers.title_original: Frequent detection of high-risk HPV types other than HPV 16/18 in a cohort of French women who claimed to have been vaccinated

analysis.research_question_and_background: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPV) causes cervical cancer, yet vaccine coverage is high in France. The study addressed whether HPV genotypes other than HPV16/18 circulate in vaccinated women undergoing cervical cancer screening.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cohort of 464 French women who reported HPV vaccination and had a cervical specimen collected was assembled. Cytology was normal in 80.6% of participants. A subset of 238 women underwent high-risk HPV screening during different study periods.
analysis.methods: Alpha-HPV detection and genotyping of 32 genotypes (including HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58) was performed using the INNO-LIPA assay (Fujirebio). High-risk HPV screening used two different tests depending on the study period.
analysis.main_results: Alpha-HPV prevalence was 59.9% with 25% of women having multiple infections. The most prevalent high-risk types were HPV52 (8.2%), HPV51 (6.9%) and HPV56 (5.8%). HPV16 was detected in 4.3% of women and present in three of four women with high-grade lesions. High-risk HPV prevalence ranged from 27.9% to 57.1% across study periods.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that high-risk HPV genotypes not covered by licensed vaccines are frequently detected in vaccinated women, while HPV16/18 prevalence is low, supporting vaccine efficacy. They note that nonavalent vaccine implementation may alter future high-risk HPV epidemiology.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest current HPV vaccines may leave a residual burden of non-vaccine high-risk types, informing surveillance strategies and future vaccine valency decisions. They underscore the need to monitor non-vaccine HPV types in vaccinated populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, lack of unvaccinated controls, and use of two different screening tests across periods, which may affect prevalence estimates. The evidence is moderate due to these methodological constraints and potential selection bias.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed HPV genotypes in 464 vaccinated French women undergoing cervical cancer screening. Alpha-HPV was detected in 59.9% of participants, with 25% having multiple infections. High-risk HPV types HPV52, HPV51 and HPV56 were most prevalent, while HPV16 was found in only 4.3% of women and present in three of four high-grade lesions. High-risk HPV prevalence varied from 27.9% to 57.1% depending on screening period. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that non-vaccine high-risk HPV types circulate despite vaccination, supporting vaccine efficacy against HPV16/18 while highlighting a residual burden of other oncogenic types. The study’s moderate-strength evidence is constrained by its cross-sectional design, lack of unvaccinated controls and use of two different screening tests across periods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 持续感染高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)可导致宫颈癌,而法国HPV疫苗接种覆盖率较高。本研究探讨了在接受宫颈癌筛查的接种疫苗女性中,除HPV16/18外的HPV基因型是否仍在流行。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究纳入了464名报告已接种HPV疫苗且已采集宫颈标本的法国女性队列。其中80.6%的参与者细胞学检查结果正常。238名女性在不同研究期间接受了高危型HPV筛查。
elements_zh.methods: 使用INNO-LIPA试剂盒(Fujirebio)检测并基因分型32种α-HPV基因型(包括HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58)。高危型HPV筛查根据研究期间采用两种不同的试剂盒。
elements_zh.main_results: α-HPV感染率为59.9%,25%的女性存在多重感染。最常见的高危型基因型为HPV52(8.2%)、HPV51(6.9%)和HPV56(5.8%)。HPV16仅在4.3%的女性中检出,且存在于四名高级别病变女性中的三名中。高危型HPV感染率在27.9%至57.1%之间,取决于研究期间。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论:未被现有疫苗覆盖的高危型HPV基因型在接种疫苗的女性中检出频繁,而HPV16/18感染率较低,这支持了疫苗的有效性。他们指出,九价疫苗的实施可能改变未来高危型HPV的流行模式。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明现有HPV疫苗可能遗留未被覆盖的高危型病毒负担,为免疫策略和未来疫苗价次决策提供参考。研究强调需在接种人群中监测未被现有疫苗覆盖的HPV基因型。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPV) causes cervical cancer, yet vaccine coverage is high in France. The study addressed whether HPV genotypes other than HPV16/18 circulate in vaccinated women undergoing cervical cancer screening.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cohort of 464 French women who reported HPV vaccination and had a cervical specimen collected was assembled. Cytology was normal in 80.6% of participants. A subset of 238 women underwent high-risk HPV screening during different study periods.
analysis_en.methods: Alpha-HPV detection and genotyping of 32 genotypes (including HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58) was performed using the INNO-LIPA assay (Fujirebio). High-risk HPV screening used two different tests depending on the study period.
analysis_en.main_results: Alpha-HPV prevalence was 59.9% with 25% of women having multiple infections. The most prevalent high-risk types were HPV52 (8.2%), HPV51 (6.9%) and HPV56 (5.8%). HPV16 was detected in 4.3% of women and present in three of four women with high-grade lesions. High-risk HPV prevalence ranged from 27.9% to 57.1% across study periods.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that high-risk HPV genotypes not covered by licensed vaccines are frequently detected in vaccinated women, while HPV16/18 prevalence is low, supporting vaccine efficacy. They note that nonavalent vaccine implementation may alter future high-risk HPV epidemiology.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest current HPV vaccines may leave a residual burden of non-vaccine high-risk types, informing surveillance strategies and future vaccine valency decisions. They underscore the need to monitor non-vaccine HPV types in vaccinated populations.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, lack of unvaccinated controls, and use of two different screening tests across periods, which may affect prevalence estimates. The evidence is moderate due to these methodological constraints and potential selection bias.

papers.title_zh: 法国接种过疫苗的女性队列研究中高危型HPV 16/18以外型别的频繁检出
papers.source_body_en: This study aimed to estimate the prevalence and distribution of HPV in a cohort of vaccinated French women undergoing cervical cancer screening (CCS). Women vaccinated against HPV (either by the bivalent HPV16/18, the quadrivalent HPV6/11/16/18 or the nonavalent HPV6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58 vaccine) and for whom a cervical specimen had been collected were included. Detection and genotyping of 32 alpha-HPV genotypes (HPV6/11/16/18/26/31/33/35/39/40/42/43/44/45/51/52/53/54/56/58/59/61/62/66/67/68/70/73/81/82/83/89) was systematically performed (INNO-LIPA, Fujirebio). In a sub-study, high-risk HPV (hrHPV) was detected using two different HPV screening tests, according to the study period. 464 vaccinated women were included. Cytology was normal for 80.6% of them. The prevalence of alpha-HPV was 59.9% in vaccinated women and 25% of whom had multiple infections. The most prevalent hrHPV genotypes were HPV52 (8.2%), HPV51 (6.9%), and HPV56 (5.8%). HPV16 was detected in only 4.3% of women and was present in three of the four women with a high-grade lesion. In the sub-study, 238 women underwent hrHPV screening. The prevalence of hrHPV ranged from 27.9% to 57.1%, depending on the study period and CCS practices. Alpha-HPV, including high-risk HPV, are frequently detected in vaccinated French women. However, most of the genotypes that have been detected are not covered by the vaccines. The prevalence of HPV 16/18 is low, which confirms the efficacy of HPV vaccines. The implementation of the nonavalent vaccine may change the future epidemiology of hrHPV genotypes.

papers.title: DEEP Model (Differences, Emotional Sensitivities, External Stressors, Communication Patterns) Versus Sexual Health Empowerment on Sexual Function and Attitude Toward Condom Use Among Women Affected with Human Papilloma Virus (HPV): A Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.abstract: Sexual dysfunction is a frequent consequence of Human Papillomavirus (HPV), besides the possibility of anogenital and oropharyngeal cancers, emphasizing the need for interventions involving couples' relationship management that address both individual and relational determinants of sexual well-being. This randomized clinical trial compared the DEEP model, grounded in differences, emotional sensitivities, external stressors, and communication patterns, with the Sexual Health Empowerment approach in improving sexual function and condom-use attitudes and behavior among women with HPV. Sixty-eight women were randomly assigned to the DEEP (n = 34) or empowerment (n = 34) group and attended eight online group counseling sessions. Sexual function scores increased from 16.09 ± 4.15 to 32.35 ± 3.50 at week 12 in the DEEP group and from 16.09 ± 4.74 to 25.30 ± 2.66 in the empowerment group. Time had a significant effect on sexual function, condom-use attitudes, and behavior in both groups (P < 0.001). Between-group differences were significant at post-intervention and follow-up for all outcomes (P < 0.001). The DEEP model produced greater and more sustained improvements, likely due to its focus on relational dynamics and partner engagement. These findings highlight the added value of couple-centered, relationship-based interventions in enhancing sexual function and protective behaviors among women with HPV.

analysis.methods: The study compared two counseling interventions delivered via online group sessions, focusing on sexual function and condom-use attitudes and behaviors as outcomes. analysis.main_results: Sexual function scores increased from 16.09 ± 4.15 to 32.35 ± 3.50 at week 12 in the DEEP group and from 16.09 ± 4.74 to 25.30 ± 2.66 in the empowerment group. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: HPV感染及其相关癌症常导致性功能障碍,亟需干预措施以应对影响性健康的个体及关系层面的决定因素。本研究旨在评估以关系动态及伴侣参与为核心的DEEP模型,是否较性健康赋权方法更能有效改善HPV感染女性的性功能及安全套使用态度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本随机临床试验纳入68名HPV感染女性,被随机分配至DEEP模型组(n=34)或性健康赋权组(n=34)。参与者在12周内参加了八次在线团体咨询。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究比较了通过在线团体咨询实施的两种咨询干预措施,以性功能及安全套使用态度与行为为结局指标。DEEP模型侧重差异、情绪敏感性、外部压力源及沟通模式,而性健康赋权方法作为对照。
elements_zh.main_results: DEEP组的性功能评分从16.09±4.15升至第12周的32.35±3.50,赋权组则从16.09±4.74升至25.30±2.66。时间对两组的性功能、安全套使用态度及行为均产生显著影响(P < 0.001),且所有结局在干预后及随访阶段的组间差异均具有统计学意义(P < 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与性健康赋权方法相比,DEEP模型在改善性功能及安全套使用态度方面产生了更大且更持久的改善效果。作者将此归因于DEEP模型对关系动态及伴侣参与的关注,并强调其在以夫妻为中心的干预中的附加价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,在改善 HPV 感染女性的性健康结果方面,以夫妇为中心、基于关系的干预措施可能比以个人为中心的方法更有效。结果支持将关系动态纳入针对感染 HPV 的女性的性健康咨询计划中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小(n = 68)并且对在线小组会议的依赖可能会限制其对更广泛人群的推广。虽然结果显示出显着改善,但缺乏 12 周以上的长期随访以及缺乏盲法引入了潜在的偏差,需要谨慎解释。由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与性健康赋权方法相比,DEEP模型在改善性功能及安全套使用态度方面产生了更大且更持久的改善效果。作者将此归因于DEEP模型对关系动态及伴侣参与的关注,并强调其在以夫妻为中心的干预中的附加价值。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,在改善 HPV 感染女性的性健康结果方面,以夫妇为中心、基于关系的干预措施可能比以个人为中心的方法更有效。结果支持将关系动态纳入针对感染 HPV 的女性的性健康咨询计划中。

papers.title: Diagnostic utility of high-risk HPV polymerase chain reaction-based testing in head and neck FNA specimens with indeterminate cytomorphology.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is critical in the initial diagnosis of many high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV)-associated, metastatic oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas. Updated guidelines recommend HR-HPV-specific polymerase chain reaction (PCR) analysis over p16 immunohistochemistry on FNA specimens because p16 performs poorly on cytology material. PCR-based assays on liquid cytology material have demonstrated excellent analytic performance; however, the diagnostic utility of a positive HR-HPV PCR result in specimens with indeterminate cytomorphology remains uncharacterized. METHODS: The authors retrospectively identified 279 head and neck FNA specimens that had paired HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material over a 5-year period. The positive predictive value for histopathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma on surgical follow-up was calculated within each cytologic interpretive category. RESULTS: The HR-HPV PCR results were positive in 50.2% of specimens, negative in 40.9%, and indeterminate in 9.0%. The HR-HPV positivity rate ranged from 0% in specimens categorized as negative for malignancy to 57.3% in cytologically positive specimens, with 19.0%, 41.2%, and 50.0% positivity in the atypical, suspicious, and nondiagnostic categories, respectively. Among cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results (n = 14), the positive predictive value was 100% (95% confidence interval, 78.5%-100.0%). Blinded slide review additionally identified 15 cytologically positive specimens in which the definitive malignant interpretation depended substantially on HR-HPV positivity; all 15 were confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma. CONCLUSIONS: A positive HR-HPV PCR result on liquid cytology material carries a positive predictive value of 100% for malignancy in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens. These findings support integrating HR-HPV PCR analysis into routine cytologic interpretation with the potential to upgrade some indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected, expediting definitive treatment and sparing patients additional, invasive sampling.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is essential for diagnosing metastatic oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas linked to high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV), yet cytomorphology alone can yield indeterminate results. The study addressed the diagnostic gap by evaluating whether HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material improves certainty in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors conducted a retrospective study over five years, analyzing 279 head and neck FNA specimens with paired HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material. The specimens were categorized by cytologic interpretive categories, including negative for malignancy, atypical, suspicious, nondiagnostic, and positive.
analysis.methods: HR-HPV PCR assays were performed on liquid cytology material, and the positive predictive value for histopathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma was calculated within each cytologic interpretive category. Blinded slide review identified specimens where definitive malignant interpretation depended on HR-HPV positivity.
analysis.main_results: HR-HPV PCR results were positive in 50.2% of specimens, negative in 40.9%, and indeterminate in 9.0%. Among cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results (n=14), the positive predictive value for malignancy was 100% (95% CI, 78.5%-100.0%). Fifteen cytologically positive specimens relied on HR-HPV positivity for definitive malignant interpretation, all confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that a positive HR-HPV PCR result on liquid cytology material carries a 100% positive predictive value for malignancy in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens. This finding supports integrating HR-HPV PCR analysis into routine cytologic interpretation to upgrade indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that HR-HPV PCR testing can expedite definitive treatment and reduce the need for additional invasive sampling in patients with indeterminate FNA findings. The findings highlight the potential for HR-HPV PCR to enhance diagnostic accuracy in head and neck oncology.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and reliance on surgical follow-up for confirmation, which may introduce selection bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of prospective validation and potential confounding from specimen selection.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated the diagnostic utility of high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material from 279 head and neck fine-needle aspiration (FNA) specimens over five years. The authors aimed to address the diagnostic uncertainty in cytologically indeterminate cases by determining whether HR-HPV PCR results could improve the positive predictive value for malignancy. HR-HPV PCR was positive in 50.2% of specimens, with positivity rates varying by cytologic category. Among 14 cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results, the positive predictive value for malignancy was 100% (95% CI, 78.5%-100.0%). Additionally, 15 cytologically positive specimens relied on HR-HPV positivity for definitive malignant interpretation, all confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma. The authors concluded that integrating HR-HPV PCR into routine cytologic interpretation could upgrade indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected, potentially expediting treatment and reducing invasive sampling. However, the retrospective design and reliance on surgical follow-up limit the evidence strength to moderate.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is essential for diagnosing metastatic oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas linked to high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV), yet cytomorphology alone can yield indeterminate results. The study addressed the diagnostic gap by evaluating whether HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material improves certainty in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The authors conducted a retrospective study over five years, analyzing 279 head and neck FNA specimens with paired HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material. The specimens were categorized by cytologic interpretive categories, including negative for malignancy, atypical, suspicious, nondiagnostic, and positive.
analysis_en.methods: HR-HPV PCR assays were performed on liquid cytology material, and the positive predictive value for histopathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma was calculated within each cytologic interpretive category. Blinded slide review identified specimens where definitive malignant interpretation depended on HR-HPV positivity.
analysis_en.main_results: HR-HPV PCR results were positive in 50.2% of specimens, negative in 40.9%, and indeterminate in 9.0%. Among cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results (n=14), the positive predictive value for malignancy was 100% (95% CI, 78.5%-100.0%). Fifteen cytologically positive specimens relied on HR-HPV positivity for definitive malignant interpretation, all confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that a positive HR-HPV PCR result on liquid cytology material carries a 100% positive predictive value for malignancy in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens. This finding supports integrating HR-HPV PCR analysis into routine cytologic interpretation to upgrade indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that HR-HPV PCR testing can expedite definitive treatment and reduce the need for additional invasive sampling in patients with indeterminate FNA findings. The findings highlight the potential for HR-HPV PCR to enhance diagnostic accuracy in head and neck oncology.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and reliance on surgical follow-up for confirmation, which may introduce selection bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of prospective validation and potential confounding from specimen selection.

papers.title_zh: 头颈部细针穿刺(FNA)标本细胞形态学不确定时高危型HPV聚合酶链反应检测的诊断价值
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is critical in the initial diagnosis of many high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV)-associated, metastatic oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas. Updated guidelines recommend HR-HPV-specific polymerase chain reaction (PCR) analysis over p16 immunohistochemistry on FNA specimens because p16 performs poorly on cytology material. PCR-based assays on liquid cytology material have demonstrated excellent analytic performance; however, the diagnostic utility of a positive HR-HPV PCR result in specimens with indeterminate cytomorphology remains uncharacterized. METHODS: The authors retrospectively identified 279 head and neck FNA specimens that had paired HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material over a 5-year period. The positive predictive value for histopathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma on surgical follow-up was calculated within each cytologic interpretive category. RESULTS: The HR-HPV PCR results were positive in 50.2% of specimens, negative in 40.9%, and indeterminate in 9.0%. The HR-HPV positivity rate ranged from 0% in specimens categorized as negative for malignancy to 57.3% in cytologically positive specimens, with 19.0%, 41.2%, and 50.0% positivity in the atypical, suspicious, and nondiagnostic categories, respectively. Among cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results (n = 14), the positive predictive value was 100% (95% confidence interval, 78.5%-100.0%). Blinded slide review additionally identified 15 cytologically positive specimens in which the definitive malignant interpretation depended substantially on HR-HPV positivity; all 15 were confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma. CONCLUSIONS: A positive HR-HPV PCR result on liquid cytology material carries a positive predictive value of 100% for malignancy in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens. These findings support integrating HR-HPV PCR analysis into routine cytologic interpretation with the potential to upgrade some indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected, expediting definitive treatment and sparing patients additional, invasive sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:细针穿刺(FNA)在多种高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)相关、转移性或原发性口咽鳞状细胞癌的初始诊断中至关重要。更新后的指南建议在FNA标本中采用HR-HPV特异性聚合酶链反应(PCR)分析而非p16免疫组化检测,因为p16在细胞学标本中的表现欠佳。基于液体细胞学标本的PCR检测已显示出优异的分析性能;然而,在细胞形态学不确定的标本中,阳性HR-HPV PCR结果的诊断价值仍未得到明确。方法:作者回顾性识别出5年内共279例头颈部FNA标本,这些标本均进行了配对的HR-HPV PCR检测(基于剩余液体细胞学标本)。在每个细胞学解释类别中,计算外科随访确诊鳞状细胞癌的阳性预测值。结果:HR-HPV PCR结果在50.2%的标本中为阳性,40.9%为阴性,9.0%为不确定。HR-HPV阳性率在各细胞学解释类别中存在差异:在诊断为恶性的标本中为57.3%,而在诊断为非恶性的标本中为0%;在“非典型”“可疑”和“无诊断意义”类别中,阳性率分别为19.0%、41.2%和50.0%。在细胞学不确定且HR-HPV PCR阳性的标本中(n=14),恶性的阳性预测值为100%(95%置信区间,78.5%-100.0%)。盲法玻片复核还识别出15例细胞学阳性标本,其明确的恶性诊断在很大程度上依赖于HR-HPV阳性结果;所有15例标本均被确诊为鳞状细胞癌。结论:在细胞形态学不确定的头颈部FNA标本中,液体细胞学标本上HR-HPV PCR阳性结果对恶性肿瘤的阳性预测值为100%。这些发现支持将HR-HPV PCR分析纳入常规细胞学诊断流程,在检测到HR-HPV时可将部分不确定标本升级为恶性诊断,从而加速确定性诊断并减少患者的侵入性取样需求。

papers.title: Prevalence of High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Infection and Associated Risk Factors Among Women Attending the Gynecology Unit in Bahir Dar, Northwest Ethiopia
papers.abstract: Background Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV), particularly types 16 and 18, is the primary cause of cervical cancer The objective of this study was to determine the prevalence of HPV types 16 and 18 and identify associated risk factors among women attending the gynecology unit in Bahir Dar, northwest Ethiopia. Methods An institution-based cross-sectional study was conducted among women attending the gynecology unit in Bahir Dar, northwest Ethiopia. A total of 344 women were selected and screened for HPV DNA. Data were collected between January and December 2025, analyzed using SPSS version 26. Cervical samples were collected and tested for HPV genotypes using the Abbott RealTime PCR System. Bivariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed. Adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals were used to determine the strength of association, and a p-value Results The prevalence of HPV infection was 38.4% (132/344). The prevalence of HPV-16 and HPV-18 was 18.3% and 6.7%, respectively, with a combined prevalence of 25.0%. Women aged 40-50 years (AOR ≈ 3.8) and >50 years (AOR ≈ 4.9) had higher odds of HPV infection compared with those aged 30-40 years. Divorced or widowed women were more likely to be infected than married women. Having two or more sexual partners, long-term use of hormonal contraceptives (>5 years), a history of sexually transmitted infections, and HIV-positive status (AOR = 2.37; 95% CI: 1.13-4.96) were significantly associated with HPV infection. Conclusion The prevalence of HPV infection among women was high, with a significant portion attributed to HPV types 16 and 18. Significant predictors included older age, marital status, multiple sexual partners, long-term use of hormonal contraceptives, and HIV infection. Strengthening HPV vaccination, improving cervical cancer screening programs, and integrating HPV prevention with HIV and STI services are crucial to reducing the burden of cervical cancer in Ethiopia.

source_records.abstract: Background Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV), particularly types 16 and 18, is the primary cause of cervical cancer The objective of this study was to determine the prevalence of HPV types 16 and 18 and identify associated risk factors among women attending the gynecology unit in Bahir Dar, northwest Ethiopia. Methods An institution-based cross-sectional study was conducted among women attending the gynecology unit in Bahir Dar, northwest Ethiopia. A total of 344 women were selected and screened for HPV DNA. Data were collected between January and December 2025, analyzed using SPSS version 26. Cervical samples were collected and tested for HPV genotypes using the Abbott RealTime PCR System. Bivariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed. Adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals were used to determine the strength of association, and a p-value 50 years (AOR ≈ 4.9) had higher odds of HPV infection compared with those aged 30–40 years. Divorced or widowed women were more likely to be infected than married women. Having two or more sexual partners, long-term use of hormonal contraceptives (>5 years), a history of sexually transmitted infections, and HIV-positive status (AOR = 2.37; 95% CI: 1.13–4.96) were significantly associated with HPV infection. Conclusion The prevalence of HPV infection among women was high, with a significant portion attributed to HPV types 16 and 18. Significant predictors included older age, marital status, multiple sexual partners, long-term use of hormonal contraceptives, and HIV infection. Strengthening HPV vaccination, improving cervical cancer screening programs, and integrating HPV prevention with HIV and STI services are crucial to reducing the burden of cervical cancer in Ethiopia.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to determine the prevalence of high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection and identify associated risk factors among women attending the gynecology unit in Bahir Dar, northwest Ethiopia. An institution-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2025, involving 344 women. Cervical samples were tested for HPV genotypes using the Abbott RealTime PCR System, and logistic regression analyses were performed to assess risk factors. The prevalence of HPV infection was 38.4%, with HPV-16 and HPV-18 accounting for 18.3% and 6.7%, respectively. Older age, divorced or widowed marital status, multiple sexual partners, long-term use of hormonal contraceptives, and HIV-positive status were significantly associated with HPV infection. The findings highlight the need for strengthening HPV vaccination, improving cervical cancer screening, and integrating HPV prevention with HIV and STI services to reduce the burden of cervical cancer in Ethiopia. The study provides valuable insights into the epidemiology of HPV in this population but does not report specific limitations or evidence strength.

papers.title: [Prevalence of cervical human papillomavirus infection among women in Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China].
papers.abstract: Objective: This study aimed to investigate the prevalence and epidemiological characteristics of cervical human papilloma virus (HPV) infection among ethnic minority and Han Chinese women in Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture of Yunnan Province to provide a theoretical basis for the strategy of cervical cancer prevention and treatment in this region. Methods: A consecutive cohort of 12,605 female residents who underwent cervical HPV genotyping across four medical centers in the Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture between January 2018 and June 2024 was enrolled. The overall HPV prevalence and genotype distribution was analyzed and the disparities in infection patterns among different ethnic groups were compared. Results: The overall HPV prevalence among women in this region was 17.88% (2,254/12,605). Infections solely with high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) predominated, with a prevalence of 14.75%, accounting for 82.48% (1,859/2,254) of all HPV-positive cases. The three most prevalent HR-HPV genotypes were HPV-52 (4.53%), HPV-16 (2.41%), and HPV-58 (2.01%). HPV infections exhibited a striking age-specific clustering among younger demographics; the prevalence in both the <20 and 20-29 years age groups reached 100%. The prevalence declined significantly with advancing age, dropping to 5.20% in the ≥60 years age group. Single-genotype infections constituted the primary pattern (74.00%, 1,668/2,254). However, multiple infections-particularly mixed infections of HR-HPV and low-risk HPV (LR-HPV)-were exceptionally prominent in the <20 years age group, peaking at 24.14%. Demographically, the overall HPV prevalence among ethnic minority women was significantly higher than that of Han women (23.14% vs. 15.62%, P<0.001), with the highest rates observed in the Dai (27.10%), Hani (26.30%), and Miao (25.17%) ethnicities. Although the general infection patterns (single vs. multiple) were similar between ethnicminority and Han women, ethnicminority women bore a significantly higher burden of specific HR-HPV types compared with Han women, including HPV-16 (3.56% vs. 1.92%), HPV-58 (3.03% vs. 1.58%), HPV-51 (2.45% vs. 1.24%), and HPV-59 (0.92% vs. 0.30%) (all P<0.05). Furthermore, inter-ethnic variations in genotype distribution were observed among the minority groups; notably, the distribution of HR-HPV-56 showed the most significant difference (P=0.018), with the highest prevalence found in women from the Dai ethnicity (3.74%). Conclusions: Cervical HPV infections among women in this region are predominantly driven by HR-HPV types 52, 16, and 58, exhibiting significant age and ethnic heterogeneity. Young women aged <30 years are highly susceptible not only to overall HPV infection, but also to mixed exposure involving multiple genotypes. Compared to Han women, ethnic minority women face a substantially more severe burden of HR-HPV infections. These findings suggest that future cervical cancer prevention and control strategies in this region should shift interventions to earlier stages, prioritizing early screening and health education for young women. Simultaneously, it is imperative to account for ethnic disparities, promote multivalent HPV vaccines that cover the predominant endemic strains, and develop targeted, precision-based prevention strategies tailored to specific ethnic regions.

papers.abstract_zh: 【摘要】:目的:调查云南省红河哈尼族彝族自治州少数民族和汉族妇女宫颈人乳头状瘤病毒(HPV)感染情况及流行病学特征,为该地区制定宫颈癌预防策略和治疗提供理论依据。方法:连续纳入 2018 年 1 月至 2024 年 6 月期间在红河哈尼族彝族自治州四个医疗​​中心接受宫颈 HPV 基因分型的 12,605 名女性居民。分析HPV 患病率总体和基因型分布,并比较不同种族之间感染模式的差异。结果:该地区女性HPV 患病率总体感染率为17.88%(2,254/12,605)。仅感染 高危型HPV (HR-HPV) 为主,患病率 为 14.75%,占所有 HPV 阳性病例的 82.48% (1,859/2,254)。三种最常见的 HR-HPV 基因型是 HPV-52 (4.53%)、HPV-16 (2.41%) 和 HPV-58 (2.01%)。HPV 感染在年轻人群中表现出显着的年龄特异性聚集;<20岁和20-29岁年龄组的患病率均达到100%。患病率随着年龄的增长而显着下降,在≥60岁组中降至5.20%。单基因型感染构成主要模式(74.00%,1,668/2,254)。然而,多重感染,特别是HR-HPV和低危型HPV(LR-HPV)的混合感染,在<20岁年龄组中尤为突出,最高达到24.14%。从人口特征来看,少数民族女性HPV 患病率总体显着高于汉族女性(23.14% vs. 15.62%,P<0.001),其中傣族(27.10%)、哈尼族(26.30%)和苗族(25.17%)感染率最高。尽管少数民族和汉族女性的一般感染模式(单发与多发)相似,但与汉族女性相比,少数民族女性特定HR-HPV类型的负担明显更高,包括HPV-16(3.56% vs. 1.92%)、HPV-58(3.03% vs. 1.58%)、HPV-51(2.45% vs. 1.24%)和HPV-59 (0.92% vs. 0.30%)(均 P<0.05)。此外,在少数群体中观察到基因型分布的种族间差异;值得注意的是,HR-HPV-56的分布差异最为显着(P=0.018),其中患病率在傣族女性中最高(3.74%)。结论:该地区女性宫颈 HPV 感染主要由 HR-HPV 52、16 和 58 型驱动,表现出显着的年龄和种族异质性。年龄<30岁的年轻女性不仅对整体HPV感染高度敏感,而且对涉及多种基因型的混合暴露也高度敏感。与汉族女性相比,少数民族女性面临着更严重的HR-HPV感染负担。这些结果表明,该地区未来的宫颈癌防控策略应将干预措施转向早期阶段,优先考虑对年轻女性的早期筛查和健康教育。同时,要考虑民族差异,推广涵盖优势流行毒株的多价HPV 疫苗,并针对特定民族地区制定有针对性、精准化的预防策略。

papers.title: Genotype distribution of high-risk and potential high-risk HPV types among women in different screening and clinic settings in Ghana and Kenya.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The burden of cervical cancer is highest in Africa. Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the major cause of cervical cancer. There are over 200 different HPV genotypes, with 15 considered (potential) high-risk genotypes for developing cancer. Due to a lack of systematic screening programs in most African countries, there is limited data available on the most prevalent HPV genotypes in the population. This study aimed to assess the prevalence and distribution of HPV genotypes in cohorts in Ghana and Kenya. analysis_zh.main_results: 加纳筛查组的 HPV 阳性率为 34.9%,其中 39.2% 的阳性病例检测到多种基因型。加纳筛查组中的主要HPV基因型是HPV-39(19.0%),在较年轻的年龄组(<30岁)中尤其流行,其次是HPV-53(15.2%)和HPV-68(15.2%)。在加纳研究小组中,HPV-53 是最常见的基因型(18.9%),其次是 HPV-39(18.0%)。在临床医生收集的组中,HPV-16 (18.6%) 是最常见的基因型。在独立寻求 HPV 检测的参与者自行收集的样本中,HPV-39 (17.9%) 和 HPV-51 (17.9%) 是最常见的基因型。在规模小得多的肯尼亚筛查组中,HPV-51 (46.2%) 是最常见的基因型。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究显示了不同环境中 HPV 基因型的分布。这强调了系统性的全人群 HPV 筛查对于了解当地 HPV 感染模式的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为加纳和肯尼亚的有针对性的 HPV 筛查和预防策略提供信息,强调需要采取针对具体情况的方法来解决不同人群中普遍存在的基因型。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于数据来源于特定筛查与检测环境,可能无法代表整体人群。证据强度为中等,基于多环境观察性数据。

papers.title: Quantification of HPV-16 and HPV-18 Neutralizing Antibodies via a Magnetic Bead-Based Competitive Chemiluminescence Platform.
papers.abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) types 16 and 18 is the primary cause of cervical cancer, and vaccination is an effective prevention method. The assessment of vaccine efficacy relies on measuring neutralizing antibodies (nAbs). However, the pseudovirion-based neutralization assay (PBNA), which is widely used as a reference method has limitations such as low throughput and technical complexity. To address this issue, we have developed a rapid and accurate magnetic bead-based competitive chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) for the separate quantitative assessment of HPV-16 and HPV-18 nAbs. This platform uses two assay configurations: HPV-16 detection involves monoclonal antibody (mAb)-coated beads and acridinium ester (AE)-labeled antigens (Ags), while HPV-18 detection involves Ag-coated beads and AE-labeled mAbs. This assay works by measuring the competitive inhibition of tracer binding by sample Abs, resulting in a chemiluminescence signal that is inversely proportional to nAbs concentration. The method has shown acceptable analytical performance, with strong linearity (R2 > 0.999) and recovery values within the predefined acceptance range for both assays. A preliminary comparison using 40 serum samples from vaccinated participants showed 97.5% agreement and a strong correlation (R2 > 0.95) with PBNA. The selected analytical parameters remained generally comparable after short-term thermal stress at 37 °C for 7 days. These findings support the analytical feasibility of the platform and its further evaluation in HPV vaccine immunogenicity studies and serological monitoring.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a magnetic bead-based competitive chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) to quantify neutralizing antibodies (nAbs) against HPV-16 and HPV-18, addressing limitations of the pseudovirion-based neutralization assay (PBNA) such as low throughput and technical complexity. The assay uses two configurations: HPV-16 detection with mAb-coated beads and AE-labeled antigens, and HPV-18 detection with antigen-coated beads and AE-labeled mAbs, measuring competitive inhibition of tracer binding to generate a chemiluminescence signal inversely proportional to nAb concentration. Preliminary validation with 40 serum samples from vaccinated participants showed 97.5% agreement and strong correlation (R2 > 0.95) with PBNA. The method demonstrated high linearity (R2 > 0.999) and acceptable recovery, supporting its analytical feasibility. The findings suggest potential for use in HPV vaccine immunogenicity studies and serological monitoring, though clinical validation and larger-scale testing are needed.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究开发了一种快速、准确的磁珠竞争化学发光免疫分析法(CLIA),用于分别定量检测HPV-16和HPV-18型中和抗体。

elements_zh.main_results: 使用40份疫苗接种参与者的血清样本进行初步比较,结果显示与假病毒颗粒中和试验(PBNA)的符合率为97.5%,且相关性良好(R2 > 0.95)。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持该平台在HPV疫苗接种免疫原性研究和血清学监测中的进一步评估。

papers.title: Incidence, Persistence, and Clearance of Anal Human Papillomavirus Infections Among Adolescent and Young Men Who Have Sex With Men in China: An Observational Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: High-risk adolescent and young men who have sex with men (MSM) populations in China experience a significant burden of human papillomavirus (HPV) infections, particularly involving HPV6, HPV11, HPV16, and HPV18. This prospective observational study investigated the prevalence, persistence, and clearance of HPV, highlighting the critical need for targeted interventions. METHODS: Adolescent and young MSM across 4 Chinese provinces participated in the UniTest Study. Anal swab samples were collected at baseline and follow-up for HPV detection and genotyping. Sociodemographic and behavioral data were obtained through self-administered questionnaires. Incidence, persistence, and clearance rates were calculated, and potential determinants were analyzed using Poisson regression models. RESULTS: The overall incidence of any HPV genotype was 42.1 per 1000 person-months (pm), with HPV16 (5.6/1000 pm), HPV6 (4.1/1000 pm), and HPV58 (3.2/1000 pm) being the most common incident genotypes. Persistent infections were observed in 28.0%, with HPV11 (4.5%), HPV6 (4.0%), and HPV16 (3.5%) as the top persistent genotypes. The clearance rate for any HPV genotype was 102.6 per 1000 pm. Participants who sought sex partners online had a higher likelihood of HPV incidence (risk ratio [RR] = 1.543, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.043-2.282), while those with above-average academic performance had a lower likelihood of HPV incidence (RR = 1.551, 95% CI 1.058-2.274). Compared with Han, other ethnicities were associated with increased HPV clearance (RR = 5.757, 95% CI 1.067-31.067). CONCLUSIONS: This study uncovers a substantial incidence of HPV infections among adolescent and young MSM in China, underscoring the imperative for focused health education and the swift implementation of customized HPV vaccination initiatives. Through the prioritization of preventive strategies and vaccination campaigns, it's possible to significantly diminish the impact of HPV infections and enhance sexual health outcomes within this at-risk group. Chinese Clinical Trial Registry, www.chictr.org.cn: ChiCTR1900020645.

papers.title_zh: 中国青年男男性行为者肛门人乳头瘤病毒感染的发病率、持续感染与清除:一项观察性队列研究
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: High-risk adolescent and young men who have sex with men (MSM) populations in China experience a significant burden of human papillomavirus (HPV) infections, particularly involving HPV6, HPV11, HPV16, and HPV18. This prospective observational study investigated the prevalence, persistence, and clearance of HPV, highlighting the critical need for targeted interventions. METHODS: Adolescent and young MSM across 4 Chinese provinces participated in the UniTest Study. Anal swab samples were collected at baseline and follow-up for HPV detection and genotyping. Sociodemographic and behavioral data were obtained through self-administered questionnaires. Incidence, persistence, and clearance rates were calculated, and potential determinants were analyzed using Poisson regression models. RESULTS: The overall incidence of any HPV genotype was 42.1 per 1000 person-months (pm), with HPV16 (5.6/1000 pm), HPV6 (4.1/1000 pm), and HPV58 (3.2/1000 pm) being the most common incident genotypes. Persistent infections were observed in 28.0%, with HPV11 (4.5%), HPV6 (4.0%), and HPV16 (3.5%) as the top persistent genotypes. The clearance rate for any HPV genotype was 102.6 per 1000 pm. Participants who sought sex partners online had a higher likelihood of HPV incidence (risk ratio [RR] = 1.543, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.043-2.282), while those with above-average academic performance had a lower likelihood of HPV incidence (RR = 1.551, 95% CI 1.058-2.274). Compared with Han, other ethnicities were associated with increased HPV clearance (RR = 5.757, 95% CI 1.067-31.067). CONCLUSIONS: This study uncovers a substantial incidence of HPV infections among adolescent and young MSM in China, underscoring the imperative for focused health education and the swift implementation of customized HPV vaccination initiatives. Through the prioritization of preventive strategies and vaccination campaigns, it's possible to significantly diminish the impact of HPV infections and enhance sexual health outcomes within this at-risk group. Chinese Clinical Trial Registry, www.chictr.org.cn: ChiCTR1900020645.

papers.title: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' Exploring the acceptability of future Human Papillomavirus self-sampling, and the barriers and facilitators of cervical cancer screening for those with intellectual disabilities in Scotland.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.

papers.title_zh: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' 探讨未来人乳头瘤病毒自我采样的可接受性,以及苏格兰智力障碍人群进行宫颈癌筛查的障碍与促进因素
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 的 宫颈癌 筛查出勤率约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比率和世界卫生组织建议的 70% 目标。HPV 自我采样可以为这一服务不足的人群提供更方便的筛查选择。本研究旨在了解患有 ID 的女性对 宫颈癌 筛查以及 HPV 自我采样的可接受性的看法和经验。方法:利用焦点小组对参与苏格兰第三部门社区团体的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,共有 13 名参与者(11 名患有智力障碍的女性,2 名护理人员)。使用反思性主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:出现了五个主题:(1) 国家卫生服务 (NHS) 沟通是痛苦的根源;(2) 医疗保健提供者和智障妇女之间的权力失衡:感觉被忽视、被忽视和失控;(3) 护理不足造成的持久后果;(4)过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;(5) 自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。结论:这项研究揭示了当前 宫颈癌 针对 ID 女性的筛查服务存在显着的系统性缺陷,同时强调了自我采样的变革潜力。成功的实施需要全面的可获取信息、加强的医疗保健专业培训和创伤知情护理方法。自我采样可以显着推进健康公平目标,同时改善这一服务不足人群的医疗保健结果。

papers.title: Aotearoa New Zealanders’ views of policies and funding for human papillomavirus vaccination and screening for cervical and lung cancers: a national survey
papers.abstract: aim: Cancer prevention and early detection are central to reducing cancer incidence, inequities and avoidable mortality in Aotearoa New Zealand. This study examined public support for human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination policies, equitable cancer screening programmes and willingness to pay more tax for healthcare funding. methods: A nationally representative, cross-sectional online survey of adults aged 18 years or older was conducted in November–December 2025 using quota sampling with oversampling of Māori and Pacific people. Participants reported support for two HPV vaccination policies (single-dose scheduling and increased public investment), two screening policies (free cervical screening and targeted lung cancer screening) and willingness to pay more tax for increased healthcare funding. Weighted analyses were conducted overall and by demographic characteristics and voting intention. results: We received a total of 1,635 responses, including 385 participants identifying as Māori (23.5%, unweighted) and 368 participants identifying as Pacific peoples (22.5%, unweighted) following oversampling of these groups of particular interest. Population estimates for support were high for all policies, including single-dose HPV vaccination (77.5%), increased HPV vaccination investment (80.3%), free cervical screening (93.4%) and targeted lung cancer screening (93.3%). Majority support was observed across demographic and political groups. Most people (62.3%) were willing to pay more tax to increase healthcare funding. conclusion: There is strong public support for HPV vaccination and screening for cervical and lung cancers. Furthermore, the majority of the Aotearoa New Zealanders are willing to pay more tax to increase healthcare funding. This indicates a clear public mandate to governments for action.

Participants reported support for two HPV vaccination policies (single-dose scheduling and increased public investment), two screening policies (free cervical screening and targeted lung cancer screening) and willingness to pay more tax for increased healthcare funding. Weighted analyses were conducted overall and by demographic characteristics and voting intention. results: We received a total of 1,635 responses, including 385 participants identifying as Māori (23.5%, unweighted) and 368 participants identifying as Pacific peoples (22.5%, unweighted) following oversampling of these groups of particular interest. Population estimates for support were high for all policies, including single-dose HPV vaccination (77.5%), increased HPV vaccination investment (80.3%), free cervical screening (93.4%) and targeted lung cancer screening (93.3%). Majority support was observed across demographic and political groups. Most people (62.3%) were willing to pay more tax to increase healthcare funding. conclusion: There is strong public support for HPV vaccination and screening for cervical and lung cancers. Furthermore, the majority of the Aotearoa New Zealanders are willing to pay more tax to increase healthcare funding. This indicates a clear public mandate to governments for action.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to examine public support for HPV vaccination policies, equitable cancer screening programs, and willingness to pay more tax for healthcare funding in Aotearoa New Zealand. A nationally representative, cross-sectional online survey of adults aged 18 years or older was conducted in November–December 2025 using quota sampling with oversampling of Māori and Pacific people. Weighted analyses were performed overall and by demographic characteristics and voting intention. Participants reported strong support for two HPV vaccination policies (single-dose scheduling and increased public investment), two screening policies (free cervical screening and targeted lung cancer screening), and willingness to pay more tax for increased healthcare funding. The results suggest that there is strong public support for HPV vaccination and screening for cervical and lung cancers, indicating a clear public mandate for government action. The study provides important insights into public opinion on cancer prevention and early detection strategies, which can inform policy decisions. The supplied evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:癌症预防与早期检测是降低新西兰癌症发病率、减少不平等和可避免死亡的核心。本研究调查了公众对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种政策、公平的癌症筛查项目及愿意为医疗保健资金增加缴税的支持度。方法:2025年11月至12月,采用配额抽样法(超额抽样毛利人和太平洋岛民)对18岁及以上成年人进行全国代表性横断面在线调查。参与者报告了对两项HPV疫苗接种政策(单剂次接种方案与公共投资增加)、两项筛查政策(免费宫颈癌筛查与针对性肺癌筛查)及愿意为增加医疗保健资金缴纳更多税款的支持度。采用加权分析,按总体及不同人口统计特征和投票意向进行分层。结果:共收到1,635份有效回复,其中385名参与者自报为毛利人(未加权占比23.5%),368名参与者自报为太平洋岛民(未加权占比22.5%),系针对这些特定群体超额抽样后的结果。所有政策的支持率均较高,包括单剂次HPV疫苗接种方案(77.5%)、HPV疫苗接种投资增加(80.3%)、免费宫颈癌筛查(93.4%)及针对性肺癌筛查(93.3%)。多数支持在不同人口统计和政治群体中均有体现。大多数人(62.3%)愿意为增加医疗保健资金缴纳更多税款。结论:新西兰民众强烈支持HPV疫苗接种及宫颈癌与肺癌筛查政策,且多数民众愿意为增加医疗保健资金缴纳更多税款。这表明公众明确授权政府采取行动。

papers.title: Acting on the Call Towards Elimination: Diagnostic Accuracy and Acceptability of Human Papilloma Virus Self-Sampling Versus Clinician-Collected Specimens in Bahrain
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer remains a significant public health challenge in Bahrain, where screening is largely opportunistic and uptake is suboptimal. Human papillomavirus (HPV) self-sampling has demonstrated diagnostic accuracy comparable to clinician-collected specimens in multiple settings and may offer a culturally congruent strategy to expand participation in cervical cancer screening, particularly in conservative communities where embarrassment related to intimate examination is a well-documented barrier. This study evaluated the feasibility, diagnostic accuracy, and acceptability of HPV self-sampling compared with clinician-collected specimens among women in Bahrain. Methods This cross-sectional diagnostic accuracy and feasibility study was conducted at King Hamad University Hospital and Primary Health Care Centres in Bahrain between July and August 2025. Women aged 21–65 years attending gynaecology or women screening clinics were recruited, enriched with a purposively selected subgroup of women with confirmed HPV-positive status from the colposcopy clinic. Each participant self-collected a cervical sample using the Rovers Cervex-Brush® deposited in PreservCyt® liquid medium, followed immediately by a clinician-collected specimen using the same device and transport medium as the reference standard. Both specimens were analysed using the Cobas® HPV test (Roche Molecular Systems). Agreement between methods was assessed using Cohen's kappa coefficient (κ), and diagnostic performance was reported as sensitivity, specificity, and predictive values with 95% Wilson confidence intervals. Acceptability and screening preferences were assessed via a structured 15-item questionnaire. Results Sixty-one women were enrolled; 53 evaluable paired specimens were available for diagnostic analysis after excluding invalid and missing results. The clinician-collected reference standard identified 7 HPV-positive cases (13.2%). Against this reference, self-collected specimens achieved a sensitivity of 85.7% (95% CI: 48.7%–97.4%), specificity of 100.0% (95% CI: 92.3%–100.0%), positive predictive value of 100.0%, and negative predictive value of 97.9% (95% CI: 88.9%–99.6%). papers.title: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS (HPV): CURRENT STRATEGIES FOR THE PREVENTION AND TREATMENT OF PRECANCEROUS LESIONS
papers.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary etiology of cervical cancer and its immediate precursors, collectively known as cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN). Although primary prevention via prophylactic vaccination and secondary screening have significantly reduced incidence, cervical cancer remains a major global health burden, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This comprehensive review evaluates the current landscape of HPV virology, pathogenesis, advanced diagnostic risk-stratification biomarkers, and evolving management paradigms. Methods: This review synthesizes current literature regarding high-risk HPV types (predominantly HPV16 and 18), viral oncogene mechanisms (E6 and E7), multi-modal screening protocols, and therapeutic interventions ranging from standard surgical excisions to novel non-invasive modalities. Results: While large loop excision of the transformation zone (LLETZ) remains the gold standard for high-grade CIN, its associated obstetric complications necessitate fertility-sparing alternatives. Recent advances highlight the efficacy of non-invasive modalities—including thermal ablation, photodynamic therapy (PDT), and topical immunomodulators such as imiquimod—which achieve high rates of lesion regression and viral clearance while preserving cervical structural integrity. Furthermore, diagnostic precision has been markedly improved through the integration of molecular markers (p16/Ki-67, DNA methylation signatures, and circulating microRNAs) and emerging microbiome-targeted adjunctive therapies. Conclusions: The management of HPV-associated precancerous lesions is shifting from standardized surgical excision to a personalized, molecularly guided, and fertility-preserving paradigm. Future clinical efforts must focus on expanding global vaccine access while implementing multi-modal, minimally invasive therapeutic strategies.
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Technologies in Social Science

Although primary prevention via prophylactic vaccination and secondary screening have significantly reduced incidence, cervical cancer remains a major global health burden, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This comprehensive review evaluates the current landscape of HPV virology, pathogenesis, advanced diagnostic risk-stratification biomarkers, and evolving management paradigms. Methods: This review synthesizes current literature regarding high-risk HPV types (predominantly HPV16 and 18), viral oncogene mechanisms (E6 and E7), multi-modal screening protocols, and therapeutic interventions ranging from standard surgical excisions to novel non-invasive modalities. Results: While large loop excision of the transformation zone (LLETZ) remains the gold standard for high-grade CIN, its associated obstetric complications necessitate fertility-sparing alternatives. Recent advances highlight the efficacy of non-invasive modalities—including thermal ablation, photodynamic therapy (PDT), and topical immunomodulators such as imiquimod—which achieve high rates of lesion regression and viral clearance while preserving cervical structural integrity. Furthermore, diagnostic precision has been markedly improved through the integration of molecular markers (p16/Ki-67, DNA methylation signatures, and circulating microRNAs) and emerging microbiome-targeted adjunctive therapies. Conclusions: The management of HPV-associated precancerous lesions is shifting from standardized surgical excision to a personalized, molecularly guided, and fertility-preserving paradigm. Future clinical efforts must focus on expanding global vaccine access while implementing multi-modal, minimally invasive therapeutic strategies.
source_records.journal: International Journal of Innovative Technologies in Social Science

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary cause of cervical cancer and its precursors, yet remains a major global health burden despite vaccination and screening advances. This review was needed to synthesize current knowledge on HPV virology, pathogenesis, diagnostic biomarkers, and evolving management strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a comprehensive literature review synthesizing current evidence on high-risk HPV types, particularly HPV16 and HPV18, and their associated precancerous lesions. It evaluates diagnostic and therapeutic approaches without specifying a defined population or study setting.
analysis.methods: The review synthesizes literature on HPV oncogene mechanisms (E6 and E7), multi-modal screening protocols, and therapeutic interventions including surgical excisions, thermal ablation, photodynamic therapy, and topical immunomodulators such as imiquimod. It also examines molecular markers (p16/Ki-67, DNA methylation signatures, circulating microRNAs) and microbiome-targeted adjunctive therapies.
analysis.main_results: The review reports that large loop excision of the transformation zone (LLETZ) remains the gold standard for high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) but is associated with obstetric complications, necessitating fertility-sparing alternatives. Non-invasive modalities such as thermal ablation, photodynamic therapy, and imiquimod achieve high rates of lesion regression and viral clearance while preserving cervical integrity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence that HPV-associated precancerous lesion management is shifting toward personalized, molecularly guided, and fertility-preserving strategies. They highlight the integration of advanced diagnostic biomarkers and minimally invasive therapies as novel developments in the field.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support expanding global vaccine access and implementing multi-modal, minimally invasive therapeutic strategies to reduce cervical cancer burden, particularly in low- and middle-income countries.
